title: A Quantum Algorithm for Simulating Nonunitary Dynamics Governed by Nonautonomous Linear Ordinary Differential Equations
summary: Nonautonomous linear ordinary differential equations of the form $\dot{v}(t) = A(t)\, v(t)$, where $A(t)$ is non-skew-symmetric, are often used to describe nonunitary dynamics in a variety of fields that range from open quantum system dynamics to economic modeling.
